message.content: On September 20th, 2026, Thane Chambers asked Li Hua about her favorite first-person shooter game. Specifically, Thane expressed curiosity and shared that he was currently playing Apex Legends, asking Li Hua what she liked most about Call of Duty: Warzone. Li Hua responded enthusiastically, praising the strategy involved in Warzone and the adrenaline rush experienced during the final circle. She also mentioned having memorable victories in the game, which Thane chimed in to share a recent instance of his own.
